sloka: तव सत्त्वं बलं चैव विजानामि महाकपे ।वायोरिव गतिं चापि तेजश्चाग्नेरिवाद्भुतम् ।। ५.३७.४०।।।।
transliteration: tava sattvaṁ balaṁ caiva vijānāmi mahākape ।vāyoriva gatiṁ cāpi tejaścāgnerivādbhutam ।। 5.37.40।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the son of Maruta in dreadful form, the broad lotus petaleyed daughter of Janaka with eyes as large as lotus petals replied :
